# skycloak_cluster (Data Source)

Look up an existing Skycloak cluster by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "skycloak_cluster" "existing" {
  id = "d290f1ee-6c54-4b01-90e6-d701748f0851"
}

output "existing_status" {
  value = data.skycloak_cluster.existing.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Cluster ID (UUID).

### Read-Only

- `auto_upgrade_enabled` (Boolean) Whether automatic patch upgrades are enabled.
- `location` (String) Region.
- `name` (String) Cluster name.
- `size` (String) Instance size.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status.
- `type` (String) Cluster type.
- `url` (String) Cluster base URL.
- `version` (String) Keycloak version.
